---
name: Proposal
about: Suggest a change, a feature, or a change to a law or an ADR
labels: enhancement
---

## The problem

Say what is wrong or missing, and who it affects.

## The change you propose

Say what should change. For a law or an ADR, a round table hears the change in your session, as [CONTRIBUTING.md](../../CONTRIBUTING.md) says.

## Other options

Say what else you considered and why you prefer this one.
